verdict.rationale: RingCentral's own Business SMS Booster add-on documents a shared inbox for customer texts, which gives the team visibility into text conversations, and a call-log API exists. Nothing shows calls and texts threaded together under a single contact record with notes; the Salesforce/HubSpot integrations would place that history in a third-party CRM, which earns no credit here. Missing for 10: unified per-contact threading of calls and texts, contact notes, team-visible combined interaction history, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
